question: Find the value of ((0.12)² + (0.123)² + (0.1234)²)/((0.012)² + (0.0123)² + (0.01234)²)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Each term in numerator is 10 times the corresponding denominator term

So squares become 100 times

Numerator = 100 × Denominator

**∴ Answer = 100**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

((0.12)² + (0.123)² + (0.1234)²) ÷ ((0.012)² + (0.0123)² + (0.01234)²)

**Formula used:**

(a × 10)² = 100a²

**Calculation:**

⇒ 0.12 = 10 × 0.012

⇒ 0.123 = 10 × 0.0123

⇒ 0.1234 = 10 × 0.01234

⇒ Square both sides

⇒ (0.12)² = 100 × (0.012)²

⇒ (0.123)² = 100 × (0.0123)²

⇒ (0.1234)² = 100 × (0.01234)²

⇒ Numerator = 100 × [(0.012)² + (0.0123)² + (0.01234)²]

⇒ Expression = 100

**∴ The correct answer is 100.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Scaling Property

If a number is multiplied by 10, its square becomes 100 times.

Decimal Shift

Moving decimal one place left divides by 10.

Common Factor Method

Take common factor from numerator and denominator to simplify.
